episodes.162983: Numerous thunderstorms moved across the nearshore waters of Brevard County, where one storm produced a strong wind gust at Buoy 41009.
episodes.162984: Numerous thunderstorms were moving across Volusia County, where one storm became strong and produced localized wind damage in New Smyrna Beach.
episodes.163227: A cold front moved through the area during the early morning hours of October 28th.  A localized area of training convection occurred across portions of Bay and southern Washington counties with around 5 inches of rainfall in 3-5 hours.  A couple of reports of flash flooding were received.
episodes.163231: A strong cold front moved through the region during the early morning hours of October 28th.  Showers and thunderstorms ahead of the front produced several strong winds gusts in excess of 34 knots across the coastal waters.
episodes.163234: Pre-frontal QLCS moves across the state south of a strong surface cyclone over the Ohio and Tennessee Valleys producing a variety of severe weather across the Florida peninsula.
episodes.163235: Pre-frontal QLCS moves across the state south of a strong surface cyclone over the Ohio and Tennessee Valleys produces a waterspout and several strong wind gusts.
episodes.163284: A surface low lifted NNE across SE GA through the day with a moist and unstable airmass across portions of northeast Florida, roughly from Gainesville to St. Augustine southward, within the warm sector of the system. A strong low level 850 mb jet of 40-50 kts  produced gusty winds in thunderstorm downdrafts where enough surface instability enabled mixing down of stronger winds.
episodes.163285: A surface low lifted NNE across SE GA through the day with a moist and unstable airmass across portions of northeast Florida, roughly from Gainesville to St. Augustine southward, within the warm sector of the system. A strong low level 850 mb jet of 40-50 kts produced gusty winds in thunderstorm downdrafts where enough surface instability enabled mixing down of stronger winds. Storms moved offshore of the local Atlantic coast in the mid afternoon.
episodes.163730: A waterspout offshore the Lower Florida Keys was followed by scattered gale-force wind gusts in association with thunderstorms forming along a pre-frontal trough.  A cold front later passed through the Florida Keys.
episodes.163947: A line of strong thunderstorms moved across the marine area and produced gusty winds.
episodes.163972: A warm front lifted north across the local area during the morning hours. This brought in a surge of warm and moist air. At the same time, mid level temperatures were dropping. That combination dramatically increased instability across the region. A line of thunderstorms and discrete cells ahead of the cold front developed and produced a few tornadoes, flash flooding, and damaging wind gusts.

events.county: Jackson
events.narrative: A tornado touched down near the intersection of Billy and 1st streets where it did some minor tree damage. It proceeded northeast where it removed a large section of the roof of a well-built home on Charles Street. It continued northeast where it did|some minor roof and tree damage. It crossed Highway 63 near Rock Creek Road where it interacted with a southbound vehicle. The driver loss control of their vehicle and died after being ejected. The tornado continued northeast where it damaged parked vehicles and the roof of homes along Gregory and Edna Streets. The tornado|proceeded northeast where it did additional minor roof and tree damage before lifting near Mary Avenue.
